rationale.conceptual: The method—a coupled structural/lattice-gas mean-field model—is an established but non-trivial technique. It requires careful derivation of the Hamiltonian and self-consistency equations, handling order parameters, and fitting to a phase diagram. The physics is specific to surface science and demands domain understanding beyond a textbook exercise.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of two main stages: implementing and solving the mean-field model, then performing a nonlinear fit. All steps use standard Python libraries (NumPy, SciPy) and straightforward file I/O. No complex tooling, data fetching, or environment setup is involved.

The physics is non-trivial but falls under established statistical mechanics methodology; the pipeline is simple with only a couple of steps and standard dependencies.
